description: Official camera modules on project-adapted OpenArm v1/S-tool mounts. Shared MJCF is displayed by MuJoCo and Viser.

visual_only.note: Visible camera/support geometry and optical viewpoints only. Existing robot inertias and contact pairs remain unchanged. This is not a full inertial model of the physical kit.

collision_envelopes.note: Explicit optional simplified outer collision envelopes; no unverified module/support inertia is invented. Not a complete physical camera-kit model.

model_pinhole_projection.note: Manufacturer maximum H/V figures are not a mutually calibrated ideal pinhole model at every mode. Simulation uses vertical 57 degrees and 1280x720, deriving horizontal FOV. Real lens calibration/distortion are not reproduced.

head.mount_reference: Project-designed post above OpenArm shoulders; source optical midpoint is shoulder height +22 cm, +8 cm along torso forward. These are project adaptation coordinates, not official OpenArm CAD mounting coordinates.

geometry.geometry_status: Official Stereolabs ZED Mini mesh; project adapter transforms checked against its URDF.

wrist.visual_envelope_depth_status: Project simplified optical barrel/housing envelope; exact assembled thickness not yet verified against CAD.

model_pinhole_projection.note: Ideal pinhole uses vertical 66 degrees at 16:10; real distortion/calibration is not reproduced. Effective FOV includes actual model occlusion.

wrist.mount_reference: Project-designed symmetric holders fixed directly to left/right J7 wrists, above the hand in matching wrist coordinates. Offsets are measured from the hand/tool installation origin using wrist axes; fixed hook rotations, including left-Z180, do not flip the camera or support. Sensors follow wrist joints, aim at the tool region, and never track the valve.
wrist.geometry_status: Simplified board/lens/housing sized from manufacturer board drawing; custom S-tool support is not the official 2.0 in-gripper assembly.

focus.near_focus_limit: not published; real near-field image sharpness requires focus adjustment/verification

wrist.board_thickness_status: The 34x34 mm board width/height are documented; the 2 mm thickness is a project visualization approximation.
wrist.board_dimensions_source_status: Official datasheet page 3 search cache gives board size 34x34 mm. Direct PDF fetch currently unavailable; no module depth or mass inferred from that board size.

notes: Only physical optical pose, ideal pinhole field of view and geometric occlusion are represented; no depth-estimation pipeline or sensor noise is simulated.
robot_head remains a compatibility alias of head_left; no synthetic center-eye stream is presented as a real stereo image.
All dimensions are metres, angles degrees, camera frame is MuJoCo -Z forward / +Y image up.
